title: spec(ui): the `ComponentPropsMap` rows still type renderer-read members as `z.unknown()` — `navigation` on object-map / object-gantt / object-tree and `conditionalFormatting` on object-kanban accept `42` — the family close-out after #21445
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a measured `reach:`**, finding class **(c)**. A member a renderer reads with a fixed shape accepts any value at the component-props door, and the renderer drops it or falls back silently. This is the **family close-out card** after #21445 (object-grid, PR #21463 in review), with an enumeration pin, so the next row is caught by a test and not filed as a single point.

`reach:` the published `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` (npm `latest`), with `ComponentPropsMap[TYPE].safeParse(...)`, the schema `os validate`'s component-props gate parses through:
- `object-map` `{ navigation: 42 }`: **ACCEPT**. Same for `object-gantt` and `object-tree`.
- `object-kanban` `{ conditionalFormatting: 42 }`: **ACCEPT**.
- Control: `object-kanban` `{ navigation: 42 }`: **REFUSE** `navigation:invalid_type`. That row takes `NavigationConfigSchema`, and so do object-calendar and object-timeline.

Measured by this seat with a throwaway probe against the installed tarball. Nothing in this repository was run. Source of the positions: the #21445 dev's report (`5960961904`, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`).

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The family on `main` `9b7a0ef3fa`

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` carries 40 `z.unknown()` members.
- **Some are deliberate.** The action bags' `bodyExtra` / `bodyShape` / `operation` / `patch` / `toast` / `resultDialog` / `onSuccess` say "forwarded to the runner".
- **The rest have no recorded reason.** Among them:
  - `navigation` on the map / gantt / tree rows (about `:5502`, `:5715`, `:6040`);
  - `conditionalFormatting` on object-kanban (about `:4670`);
  - the metric row's `trend` / `drillDown` / `compareTo` (about `:4267-4269`);
  - the form row's `customFields` / `contentLayout` / `submitBehavior` / `navigateOnSuccess` / `mobile` (about `:5002-5035`);
  - and others.
- #21445 types the object-grid row's seven.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Each `z.unknown()` member the renderer reads with a fixed shape is typed by reference where a schema already declares that member (`NavigationConfigSchema`, the list view's `conditionalFormatting`, and so on), and to the renderer's read at the `.objectui-sha` pin otherwise, as #21445 did. ⛔ No `z.unknown()` for a member a renderer reads with a fixed shape.
- A member forwarded verbatim to a runner keeps `z.unknown()` only with its reason in the `.describe()`.
- **Enumeration pin:** every `z.unknown()` member across `ComponentPropsMap` is either typed or listed with its recorded reason. A new `z.unknown()` then fails the pin until it carries one.
- A census of authored writers at the pin precedes each narrowing, as #21445's did.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed, 「ComponentPropsMap z.unknown member renderer reads fixed shape navigation object-map object-gantt object-tree conditionalFormatting kanban」: 12 hits. #21445 (open) is the object-grid row. #20831 (closed) is the object-kanban `grouping`. #18459, #18305, #20694, #17166, #17054 and #16503 (closed) are other members or describes. None covers the remaining `z.unknown()` members.

Dedupe words: `ComponentPropsMap z.unknown family` · `navigation z.unknown object-map gantt tree` · `kanban conditionalFormatting z.unknown`
